button-missing-design-system-class.note: Interactive elements with no btn-* chrome class. Fix by adding the correct variant (btn-primary / btn-secondary / btn-danger / btn-ghost / btn-tab) and deleting the ad-hoc fill; do not raise this ceiling to silence a new button.

emoji-as-ui-glyph.note: Emoji standing in for a design-system icon. Fix by swapping in a monochrome currentColor icon from the existing icon set.

ambiguous-button-label.note: Buttons whose whole label is a bare action verb that is used more than once in the component tree, so the object is unstated. Fix by naming the object in the label (i18n key + both locales).

button-geometry-off-token.note: Widened scope: the `*Btn` suffix is now a selected token, so every `…Btn` call site — where the residual off-token radii lived — is measured too. The accompanying token fixes shipped in the same PR, so maxViolations is 0 and known is empty; the two remaining matches are justified exemptions (loading-skeleton chip placeholder, universal :focus-visible inherit). Fix new geometry with --btn-h-sm/md/lg and --radius-btn/--radius-full; never raise this ceiling.

button-geometry-off-token::components/sh.reason: Loading skeleton placeholder (`<span aria-hidden>`), not an interactive element: its 22px height is the skeleton's own shimmer scale, so a button hit-area token would be wrong (#1258).

button-geometry-off-token::styles/global.reason: Universal keyboard focus indicator: `border-radius: inherit` deliberately follows each focused element's own shape, so pinning it to --radius-btn would square off every focused input and card (#1258).
